title: Custom Software Engineering Lead
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineering Lead  

**Project Role Description :** Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  

**Must have skills :** SAP Sales and Distribution (SD)  

**Good to have skills :** SAP ABAP Cloud  

Minimum **15** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Custom Software Engineering Lead, a typical day involves overseeing the technical direction and architectural design of custom software solutions. This role requires guiding teams through the entire development lifecycle, from initial design concepts to final delivery. The position focuses on establishing development standards and ensuring that the software meets high benchmarks for quality, scalability, and performance. Collaboration with various stakeholders to align technical efforts with business goals is a key aspect, along with continuous monitoring and refinement of processes to drive successful project outcomes.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
* Should have Influencing and Advisory skills.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the adoption of best practices and innovative approaches to software development within the team.
* Mentor and support team members to foster professional growth and enhance technical capabilities.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in SAP Sales and Distribution (SD).
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with SAP ABAP Cloud.
* Strong understanding of software architecture principles and design patterns relevant to enterprise solutions.
* Experience in managing and optimizing software development processes to ensure high\-quality deliverables.
* Ability to analyze complex technical challenges and develop scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Familiarity with integration techniques and tools to connect SAP modules with other enterprise systems.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 6 years of experience in SAP Sales and Distribution (SD).


\- This position is based at our KDC1A \- SEZ location.  

* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

title: DATA MANAGEMENT EXECUTIVE / ERP DEVELOPER EXECUTIVE
description:
Job description:

We are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented ERP Executive / ERP Developer to manage, maintain, and develop our ERP system while ensuring strong MIS reporting and data management capabilities. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with process flow management, flowcharts, and various management systems such as FMS, IMS, and MIS.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and maintain the organization's ERP system, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day functioning.
* Develop, customize, and enhance ERP modules as per business requirements.
* Design, prepare, and maintain process flowcharts for different business operations.
* Handle process flow management to streamline operational processes across departments.
* Collect, organize, and maintain accurate data across departments and systems.
* Ensure data integrity, cleanliness, and consistency in the ERP system and related databases.
* Prepare, update, and maintain MIS reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of all MIS reports to the management team.
* Coordinate with different departments to gather data and validate records in the ERP system.
* Maintain confidentiality and security of sensitive company data.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven experience in ERP system management and/or ERP development.
* Strong knowledge of data management practices and MIS reporting.
* Proficiency in creating process flowcharts (Google Sheets/docs, flowchart tools or similar.
* Working knowledge of FMS, IMS, and MIS systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Dashboards, etc.)
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and ensure timely report submission.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund
